criterion: With the GIS catalogue open, entering `TEST2-no-match-showcase-20261012` leaves the query visible and shows no matching catalogue entries, including no Surveyor result.
steps_taken: Navigated to launcher and captured initial state.
Opened GIS.
Entered TEST2-no-match-showcase-20261012; query remained visible and catalogue showed no entries, including Surveyor.
Cleared test query to restore catalogue.
observed: Unique query remained visible; No layers match this search appeared, with no Surveyor entry.

criterion: Replacing that query with `Surveyor` without reloading shows the Surveyor matching entry.
steps_taken: Navigated to launcher and captured initial state.
Opened GIS and waited for map loading to finish.
Entered unmatched query and observed no catalogue matches.
Replaced query with Surveyor without reloading; observed Surveyor catalogue entry.
Cleared test query.
observed: Replacing the unmatched query with Surveyor without reload displayed the Surveyor catalogue entry.

criterion: Opening the Surveyor configuration displays an editable Username field and Cancel and Add layer controls.
steps_taken: Navigated to launcher and captured initial state.
Opened GIS and waited for map loading to finish.
Searched Surveyor.
Opened Surveyor configuration.
Cancelled configuration and cleared query.
observed: Surveyor configuration showed Username (empty, enabled and not read-only), Cancel and Add layer.

criterion: Entering `TEST2-showcase-unsaved-20261012` in Username and selecting Cancel without Add layer closes the configuration; reopening the same configuration shows an empty Username field.
steps_taken: Navigated to launcher and captured initial state.
Opened GIS and waited for map loading to finish.
Searched Surveyor and opened its configuration.
Entered TEST2-showcase-unsaved-20261012 into Username.
Selected Cancel; configuration closed without adding a layer.
Reopened same Surveyor configuration; Username was empty.
Cancelled reopened configuration and cleared query.
observed: Cancel closed the configuration without adding a layer; reopening the same configuration showed empty Username.

criterion: After cancelling the reopened configuration and clearing the catalogue query, the search field is empty and the original catalogue entries and browsing position are restored.
steps_taken: Navigated to launcher and captured initial state.
Opened GIS and waited for map loading to finish.
Recorded original catalogue; entered unmatched query, replaced with Surveyor, and opened its configuration.
Entered synthetic Username, cancelled, and reopened with empty Username.
Cancelled reopened configuration and cleared query.
observed: After cancelling the reopened configuration and clearing query, search was empty. Original catalogue text and scroll position (0) matched the baseline; screenshot comparison confirmed restored visible entries.

criterion: After these actions, the visible map and complete active-layer list match their recorded initial states, with no Surveyor layer added.
steps_taken: Navigated to launcher and captured initial state.
Opened GIS and waited for map loading to finish.
Recorded original map and complete active-layer list, then searched unmatched query, replaced with Surveyor and opened its configuration.
Entered synthetic Username, cancelled, and reopened with an empty Username.
Cancelled reopened configuration and cleared query without selecting Add layer in the dialog.
observed: Original and final map extent and visible features matched. Complete active-layer list contained only ALL Coverage Gap Candidate Areas before and after; no Surveyor layer was added. The pre-existing coverage gap load error remained unchanged.
